source: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems (ps) table, all references, via public/catalog (tools/build_catalog.py); TESS candidates: the archive's toi table (ExoFOP-TESS), via public/catalog-table/toi.json
format: [host name, ra_deg, dec_deg, V magnitude or null, number of confirmed planets, discovery groups, candidates or null, [Teff K, distance pc, spectral class, transits 0/1]], brightest first (V, else TESS T); groups: t transit, r radial velocity, i imaging, m microlensing, o other (TTV, astrometry, timing, ...), the one that found most planets first, then c (TESS candidates); candidates: [TESS magnitude, TIC, [[TOI, period d, error, epoch BJD_TDB, error, duration h, depth ppm, TFOPWG disposition]]]
